rounds.text: Khandwala Securities Ltd (KHANDSE) is under-appreciated based on the evidence provided. Additionally, the company's compounded sales growth over the last five years at 16% exceeds the sector median of 14.3%, further supporting a bullish case for KHANDSE [E14] and [E57]. These factors collectively suggest that KHANDSE is being underappreciated and deserves a reassessment.
